## Summary

I implemented **F007 — the acknowledge path, the ONLY marker-write surface (D015)** for plan 2026-06-21-001. In `scripts/dontpanic_doctor.py` I added `acknowledge_upgrade()`, which reads the effective marker (F004), assembles a pre-acknowledge report to learn the currently-shown advisories + installed commit, then calls F004's `advance_marker` (to the latest release) and `dismiss_advisory` (for every visible advisory key), commits via the sole writer `write_upgrade_state`, and re-reads + re-assembles so the returned report reflects the **committed** marker (D027); it stamps `first_initialized_at` once and never persists the off-git `unknown` commit sentinel. The `--acknowledge` flag is wired into both `doctor.main()` (composing with `--upgrade`/`--json`, else printing a concise `render_acknowledge_confirmation`) and the public `cli.py` wrapper (delegated to `jd.main`, alongside `--upgrade`). The **critical D004 invariant** is preserved by construction: required-action pending-ness is owned solely by the live `status_probe`, so a probe-failing required action stays pending after acknowledge.

I added `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_doctor_acknowledge_f007.py` (15 tests) covering marker advance+commit, off-git no-commit, first-stamp preservation, advisory silencing (incl. surviving a fresh read), the acknowledge-does-not-clear-probe-failing-required invariant (+ a passing-probe control), acknowledge as
